protocol.purpose: Diagnosis only: unchanged stand and exact historical walking protocols, not a third walking attempt or parameter search.
notes: Hold robot state and processed-action history at nominal stand t=1.60 s for all static probes.
Change the left knee at exactly one of the four future time slots per probe; additionally test one right-knee, velocity, and anchor-rotation channel.
Compare complete historical swing references against stand at the identical held state/history.
Collect torque utilization at all 1000 Hz physics evaluations, not just control samples.
No gains, limits, reference trajectories, initialization, inference actions, or walking criteria are changed.
